mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent negative GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals an overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: overheating economy with loose monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 jobs in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the decline in PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and FEDFUNDS is above 2%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in a slow-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in slow-growth environment
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low GDPC1 growth and high FEDFUNDS does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.
